title: Adiabatic Deformations of Black Hole Moduli: I. Canonical Slices and Fredholm Solvability
summary: The leading adiabatic response of a static black hole to a slowly evolving asymptotic modulus separates into a geometric problem and a functional-analytic one: the former identifies the tangent direction on the manifold of static solutions actually followed by the black hole, and the latter determines whether the resulting deformation admits a unique solution. We show that both can be characterized by explicit scalar criteria. Differentiating a smooth family of static solutions defines an intrinsic covector on its tangent space.
